answer_1.quote: In this work, we address these challenges of contextual commonsense knowledge generation by developing Diffusion COMmonsEnse Transformer models... Given a narrative sample S as context, the model needs to generate commonsense inferences.
answer_1.outputs: Textual commonsense facts expressed as triples (head, relation, tail) in natural language

answer_2.quote: We evaluate DIFFUCOMET models using traditional NLG metrics (e.g., BLEU; ...) and also propose novel evaluation metrics that assess the diversity and contextual relevance of generated knowledge.

answer_4.quote: We hire Amazon Mechanical Turk workers to evaluate the validity and contextual relevance of models' generated knowledge on the ROCStories portion of ComFact. Specifically, given a narrative context and a list of generated facts, we ask three workers to independently judge whether each fact is valid (i.e., plausible and natural-sounding) and relevant to the context.
answer_4.guideline: Workers are asked to judge each generated fact for validity (plausibility and naturalness) and relevance to the narrative context.
